title: Collateral Massacre
overview: In Roanapur, the new head of the Lovelace family makes an offer to Rock and the Lagoon Company, while the vengeful Roberta appears seeking weapons.

title: An Office Man's Tactics
overview: Rock searches for Roberta even as she accumulates the equipment she needs to wage war. Roanapur's crime lords meet to discuss the volatile situation.

title: Angels in the Crosshairs
overview: Roberta engages in combat with U.S. soldiers as well as FARC fighters, one of whom tries to recruit her into their cause. Garcia tries to intervene.

title: Oversaturation Kill Box
overview: Rock and Chang ask Dutch and the Lagoon Company to get the Americans out of town, while Roberta continues her attacks.

title: Codename Paradise, Status MIA
overview: The Black Lagoon arrives in the Golden Triangle, where the Americans are attacked by Roberta, leading to a final confrontation.
